evidence.model_deprecation: GPT-4, GPT-3.5-turbo deprecated with forced migration to newer models
evidence.no_version_pin: Cannot pin to specific model version; aliases auto-upgrade (e.g., gpt-4o -> gpt-4o-2024-08-06)
evidence.behavioral_drift: Model behavior changes between versions without detailed changelog
evidence.safety_filter_tightening: Moderation API and safety identifiers encourage self-censorship to avoid policy violations
evidence.prompt_engineering_pressure: Documentation recommends constraining inputs, limiting outputs, using dropdowns vs open text
evidence.model_retirement_schedule: Models retired with 60+ days notice but no opt-out; forced migration
evidence.context_compaction: New feature 'Context Compaction' may alter conversation history

impact.description: Content drift induced by forced model migrations, auto-upgrading aliases, behavioral changes without opt-out, and safety filter pressure. Developers must self-censor (constrain inputs, limit outputs, use dropdowns) to avoid policy violations. Model retirement removes access to stable behaviors. No version pinning means production apps can break silently.

remediation.notes: Best practices: test with new models early, use safety identifiers, implement human-in-the-loop
